description: This file defines an internal class 'InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache' that manages mappings between grain interface methods and their implementations, including support for generic methods. It includes nested classes and methods for creating and retrieving these mappings, primarily used within the Orleans framework for grain interface management.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache
classes.description: Manages a cache mapping between grain interface methods and their implementation methods, supporting generic method instantiation.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache.Entry
classes.description: Represents a mapping entry between an interface method and its implementation method, with support for generic method construction.

methods.name: GetOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a mapping from interface methods to implementation methods for specified implementation and interface types.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceToImplementationMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping of interface types to their method mappings for a given implementation type.
